text: In September 2014, 43 of us said "regulatory overreach protection act," first said on 2014-07-11 by D000612. Forty-three of us said "waters of the united states," first said on 2013-04-23 by John Barrasso. Forty of us said "clean water act." Fifty-three of us said "of the united states," first said on 2013-01-03 by Scott DesJarlais. Thirty-nine of us said "of the united states regulatory overreach"; thirty-eight said "the united states regulatory overreach protection." Each of these peaked on 2014-09-09. We converged that day on the same clause, the same order of words, "waters of the united states regulatory," forty of us in step. The record shows us naming one act, in one voice, on one day.
